statement: At the FOMC meeting concluding 2026-09-16, the Federal Reserve raises the federal funds target range above the 3.50 to 3.75 percent range held at seal, so that FRED series DFEDTARU (target range upper limit) prints 4.00 or higher for 2026-09-17.
resolution: FRED series DFEDTARU (federal funds target range upper limit) shows a value of 4.00 or higher for 2026-09-17. Reference at seal: 3.75 percent upper limit on the packet date.
failure_condition: DFEDTARU for 2026-09-17 prints 3.75 or lower, meaning the FOMC held or cut at the meeting concluding 2026-09-16.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
